title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares Bought by Nicolet Bankshares Inc.
text:

Nicolet Bankshares Inc. increased its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.4% during the third quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The firm owned 26,077 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 619 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up 1.8% of Nicolet Bankshares Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 12th biggest holding. Nicolet Bankshares Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,019,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period. 
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also bought and sold shares of AAPL. Hoertkorn Richard Charles lifted its holdings in Apple by 1.2% in the 2nd quarter. Hoertkorn Richard Charles now owns 45,281 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,521,000 after purchasing an additional 549 shares in the last quarter. Moon Capital Management LLC lifted its holdings in Apple by 44.8% in the 2nd quarter. Moon Capital Management LLC now owns 8,430 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,214,000 after purchasing an additional 2,610 shares in the last quarter. Leavell Investment Management Inc. lifted its holdings in Apple by 0.7% in the 2nd quarter. Leavell Investment Management Inc. now owns 99,376 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $14,312,000 after purchasing an additional 681 shares in the last quarter. Fenimore Asset Management Inc. purchased a new position in Apple in the 2nd quarter worth approximately $204,000. Finally, Chesley Taft & Associates LLC lifted its holdings in Apple by 0.5% in the 2nd quarter. Chesley Taft & Associates LLC now owns 83,886 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,081,000 after purchasing an additional 403 shares in the last quarter. 60.23% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. In other Apple news, insider Johny Srouji sold 10,368 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, November 24th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.68, for a total value of $1,811,082.24. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 81,560 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $14,246,900.80. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Thursday, December 7th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.69, for a total value of $2,654,121.29. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 17,341 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,942,594.29. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155 in the last ninety days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders. Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $159.54 on Thursday. The company has a market capitalization of $809,510.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 16.41, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.23 and a beta of 1.33. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $130.45 and a 12-month high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company posted $3.36 EPS. equities research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.4 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
The firm also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th will be given a $0.63 dividend. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.58%. The ex-dividend date is Friday, February 9th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 25.93%. 
Several brokerages have recently issued reports on AAPL. ValuEngine cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Thursday. Goldman Sachs Group began coverage on Apple in a report on Wednesday. They set a “neutral” rating and a $161.00 price objective on the stock. William Blair reaffirmed an “outperform” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, February 2nd. KeyCorp reaffirmed an “equal weight” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Sunday. Finally, Morgan Stanley upped their price objective on Apple from $200.00 to $203.00 and gave the stock an “overweight” rating in a report on Friday, February 2nd. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have issued a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.72.
